items.title: Firefly: Season 1, Episode 11 "Serenity"
items.description:
Description: "Malcolm Reynolds is a veteran and the captain of Serenity. He and his crew are smuggling goods, but they need to pick up some passengers for extra money. However, not all the passengers are what they seem."
release date: 8 Sep. 2003

items.title: Firefly: Season 1, Episode 2 "Bushwhacked"
items.description:
Description: "Serenity is pulled in by an Alliance cruiser while investigating a spaceship that was attacked by Reavers. Simon and River must hide to prevent capture, while something is wrong with the lone survivor of the attacked spaceship."
date released: 27 Sep. 2002

items.title: Firefly: Season 1, Episode 10 "Objects in Space"
items.description:
Description: "Serenity encounters a ruthlessly professional bounty hunter, Jubal Early, who will stop at nothing to retrieve River. But River, feeling unwelcome on the ship, takes a novel approach to escaping from the Alliance."
release date: 13 Dec. 2002

items.title: Firefly: Season 1, Episode 8 "Ariel"
items.description:
Description: "Serenity travels to the core world Ariel and Simon comes up with a plan to steal drugs from the hospital."
release date: 15 Nov. 2002

items.title: Firefly: Season 1, Episode 6 "Shindig"
items.description:
Description: "In order to secure a job transporting cargo off-planet for a client, Mal attends a social event where a dance with Inara leads to him being challenged to a swordfight in defense of her honor."
release date: 1 Nov. 2002

items.title: Firefly: Season 1, Episode 3 "Our Mrs. Reynolds"
items.description:
Description: "A woman claiming to be Mal's wife appears aboard Serenity"
release date: 4 Oct. 2002

items.title: Firefly: Season 1, Episode 1 "The Train Job"
items.description:
Description: "Mal has second thoughts after discovering that two boxes of Alliance goods his crew has been hired to steal are full of badly needed medical supplies headed for the mining town of Paradiso."
date released: 20 Sep. 2002
